# readlink

Resolve paths using GNU readlink canonicalization modes.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/readlink -e .
moonx cli/readlink -m new/folder
```

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f`, `--canonicalize` | Allow a missing final component. |
| `-e`, `--canonicalize-existing` | Require every component to exist. |
| `-m`, `--canonicalize-missing` | Allow missing components. |
| `-z`, `--zero` | Terminate paths with NUL. |
| `-n`, `--no-newline` | Omit the newline for a single operand. |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | Report lookup errors. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Physical canonicalization can resolve existing links. Reading stored link text, including the spelling of a dangling target, requires a public Wasm binding.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md).
